originalTitle: Stocks to buy under  ₹200: Amid escalation in US-Iran war, Mehul Kothari of Anand Rathi recommends three shares to buy
simplifiedContent: There's been a big increase in tension between the US and Iran, which has made investors nervous and caused the Indian stock market to go down for five days in a row. The two main measures of the Indian stock market, called the Nifty 50 and Sensex, have both fallen by more than 2.5%, which is the worst they've done in four months. This volatility is making investors unsure, but some analysts think it's a good time to buy stocks when they're low. They're suggesting a "buy on dips" strategy, which means buying stocks when their prices are down. This could be a good opportunity for investors to buy shares at lower prices.
